workflow_lapses: The first read-only Git summary used invalid PowerShell grouping around a native command and failed at parse time before producing state.

The first fresh receipt prose manually repeated three Git object IDs even though the receipt requires its machine snapshot to own those values; the rejected receipt was preserved and the corrected receipt passed with zero manual IDs.
The threat delta first described the unchanged not-ready verdict without its exact closed-vocabulary token; the focused test rejected it and the token was added.
The next focused run exposed the same prose-versus-token omission for the remaining environment gap; the exact dimension ID was added and the third focused run passed.

The first clockwork check supplied a descriptive Baton acceptance label outside the hash-bound active-label vocabulary; the check failed closed before generation and the corrected intent reused the existing rolling label.
bounded_conclusion: The tranche removed one substantive readiness uncertainty without adding a reusable control layer or spending another runtime action. Five cheap lapses show that the workflow is not infallible, but each was contained before publication and none widened product authority.
